accepted.name: customers_dim_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "CustomerID" AS customer_id,
  "CustomerName" AS customer_name,
  "BillToCustomerID" AS bill_to_customer_id,
  "CustomerCategoryID" AS customer_category_id,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER("BuyingGroupID") AS buying_group_id,
  "PrimaryContactPersonID" AS primary_contact_person_id,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER("AlternateContactPersonID") AS alternate_contact_person_id,
  "DeliveryMethodID" AS delivery_method_id,
  "DeliveryCityID" AS delivery_city_id,
  "PostalCityID" AS postal_city_id,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER("CreditLimit") AS credit_limit,
  "AccountOpenedDate" AS account_opened_date,
  "StandardDiscountPercentage" AS standard_discount_percentage,
  "IsStatementSent" AS is_statement_sent,
  "IsOnCreditHold" AS is_on_credit_hold,
  "PaymentDays" AS payment_days,
  "PhoneNumber" AS phone_number,
  "FaxNumber" AS fax_number,
  "DeliveryAddressLine1" AS delivery_address_line1,
  "DeliveryAddressLine2" AS delivery_address_line2,
  "DeliveryPostalCode" AS delivery_postal_code,
  "DeliveryLocation" AS delivery_location,
  "PostalAddressLine1" AS postal_address_line1,
  "PostalAddressLine2" AS postal_address_line2,
  "PostalPostalCode" AS postal_postal_code,
  "LastEditedBy" AS last_edited_by,
  "ValidFrom" AS valid_from,
  "ValidTo" AS valid_to
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.SALES_CUSTOMERS
accepted.description: Cleaned customer dimension projection. Normalizes column names, casts types where reasonable, and exposes key attributes and contact info for joins and reporting. Use this as the canonical customers table for downstream joins, filters, and aggregations. | Use for: Join customers to orders/invoices/transactions; Customer demographic reporting (counts by category, credit status); Filtering active customers by ValidFrom/ValidTo or credit hold flags

accepted.name: invoices_fact_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "InvoiceID" AS invoice_id,
  "CustomerID" AS customer_id,
  "BillToCustomerID" AS bill_to_customer_id,
  "OrderID" AS order_id,
  "DeliveryMethodID" AS delivery_method_id,
  "ContactPersonID" AS contact_person_id,
  "AccountsPersonID" AS accounts_person_id,
  "SalespersonPersonID" AS salesperson_person_id,
  "PackedByPersonID" AS packed_by_person_id,
  "InvoiceDate" AS invoice_date,
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_NUMBER(TO_VARCHAR("CustomerPurchaseOrderNumber")) IS NOT NULL THEN TRY_TO_NUMBER(TO_VARCHAR("CustomerPurchaseOrderNumber"))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS customer_purchase_order_number,
  "IsCreditNote" AS is_credit_note,
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_NUMBER(TO_VARCHAR("CreditNoteReason")) IS NOT NULL THEN TRY_TO_NUMBER(TO_VARCHAR("CreditNoteReason"))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS credit_note_reason,
  "Comments" AS comments,
  "DeliveryInstructions" AS delivery_instructions,
  "TotalDryItems" AS total_dry_items,
  "TotalChillerItems" AS total_chiller_items,
  "ReturnedDeliveryData" AS returned_delivery_data,
  "ConfirmedDeliveryTime" AS confirmed_delivery_time,
  "ConfirmedReceivedBy" AS confirmed_received_by,
  "LastEditedBy" AS last_edited_by,
  "LastEditedWhen" AS last_edited_when
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.SALES_INVOICES
accepted.description: Canonical invoices fact projection. Normalizes invoice identifiers, exposes date as raw string, numeric flags and key foreign keys used for joins and aggregations. | Use for: Aggregate invoice totals by customer/date; Join invoices to invoice lines, customers, and transactions

accepted.name: invoice_lines_with_item
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  il."InvoiceLineID" AS invoice_line_id,
  il."InvoiceID" AS invoice_id,
  il."StockItemID" AS stock_item_id,
  il."Description" AS description,
  il."PackageTypeID" AS package_type_id,
  il."Quantity" AS quantity,
  il."UnitPrice" AS unit_price,
  il."TaxRate" AS tax_rate,
  il."TaxAmount" AS tax_amount,
  il."LineProfit" AS line_profit,
  il."ExtendedPrice" AS extended_price,
  si."StockItemName" AS stock_item_name,
  si."IsChillerStock" AS is_chiller_stock,
  si."SupplierID" AS supplier_id,
  il."LastEditedBy" AS last_edited_by,
  il."LastEditedWhen" AS last_edited_when
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.SALES_INVOICELINES il
LEFT JOIN WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WAREHOUSE_STOCKITEMS si
  ON il."StockItemID" = si."StockItemID"
grain: invoice_line_id, one row per invoice line
accepted.description: Denormalized invoice lines joined to stock item basic attributes. One row per invoice line with item name, unit price and tax info for reporting and profitability analysis. | Use for: Sales by item / item profitability; Chiller vs dry sales analysis; Join to supplier or stock holdings to assess availability

accepted.name: orders_with_customer
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  o."OrderID" AS order_id,
  o."CustomerID" AS customer_id,
  o."SalespersonPersonID" AS salesperson_person_id,
  o."ContactPersonID" AS contact_person_id,
  o."OrderDate" AS order_date,
  o."ExpectedDeliveryDate" AS expected_delivery_date,
  o."CustomerPurchaseOrderNumber" AS customer_purchase_order_number,
  o."IsUndersupplyBackordered" AS is_undersupply_backordered,
  o."Comments" AS comments,
  c."CustomerName" AS customer_name,
  c."DeliveryMethodID" AS customer_delivery_method_id,
  c."IsOnCreditHold" AS customer_is_on_credit_hold
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.SALES_ORDERS o
LEFT JOIN WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.SALES_CUSTOMERS c
  ON o."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
accepted.description: Sales orders enriched with basic customer attributes. One row per order for order-level reporting and to join to order lines. | Use for: Order aging and fulfillment analysis; Join to order lines and invoices for revenue recognition

accepted.name: stock_holdings_current
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "StockItemID" AS stock_item_id,
  MAX("QuantityOnHand") AS quantity_on_hand,
  MAX("BinLocation") AS bin_location,
  MAX("LastStocktakeQuantity") AS last_stocktake_quantity,
  MAX("LastCostPrice") AS last_cost_price,
  MAX("ReorderLevel") AS reorder_level,
  MAX("TargetStockLevel") AS target_stock_level,
  MAX("LastEditedBy") AS last_edited_by,
  MAX("LastEditedWhen") AS last_edited_when
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WAREHOUSE_STOCKITEMHOLDINGS
GROUP BY "StockItemID"
grain: stock_item_id, one row per stock item
accepted.description: Aggregated stock holdings per stock item providing current on-hand quantity and basic inventory metrics (reorder/target). One row per stock item. | Use for: Inventory availability checks; Reorder/fill level alerts and stock valuation

accepted.name: stock_transactions_agg_by_item_day
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "StockItemID" AS stock_item_id,
  "TransactionTypeID" AS transaction_type_id,
  TO_DATE("TransactionOccurredWhen") AS transaction_date,
  SUM("Quantity") AS total_quantity,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  MAX("LastEditedWhen") AS last_edited_when
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WAREHOUSE_STOCKITEMTRANSACTIONS
GROUP BY "StockItemID", "TransactionTypeID", TO_DATE("TransactionOccurredWhen")
grain: stock_item_id, transaction_type_id, transaction_date — one row per item/type/day
accepted.description: Daily aggregated stock transactions per stock item and transaction type. Useful for time-series inventory flow analysis and replenishment computations. | Use for: Inbound vs outbound daily flows; Rolling inventory consumption by item; Detection of unusual transaction spikes

accepted.name: latest_stockitem_valid_version
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  stock_item_id,
  stock_item_name,
  supplier_id,
  color_id,
  unit_package_id,
  outer_package_id,
  brand,
  size,
  lead_time_days,
  quantity_per_outer,
  is_chiller_stock,
  barcode,
  tax_rate,
  unit_price,
  recommended_retail_price,
  typical_weight_per_unit,
  marketing_comments,
  internal_comments,
  photo,
  custom_fields,
  tags,
  search_details,
  last_edited_by,
  valid_from,
  valid_to,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_item_id ORDER BY valid_from DESC NULLS LAST) AS version_row_number
FROM (
  SELECT
    "StockItemID" AS stock_item_id,
    "StockItemName" AS stock_item_name,
    "SupplierID" AS supplier_id,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER("ColorID") AS color_id,
    "UnitPackageID" AS unit_package_id,
    "OuterPackageID" AS outer_package_id,
    "Brand" AS brand,
    "Size" AS size,
    "LeadTimeDays" AS lead_time_days,
    "QuantityPerOuter" AS quantity_per_outer,
    "IsChillerStock" AS is_chiller_stock,
    "Barcode" AS barcode,
    "TaxRate" AS tax_rate,
    "UnitPrice" AS unit_price,
    "RecommendedRetailPrice" AS recommended_retail_price,
    "TypicalWeightPerUnit" AS typical_weight_per_unit,
    "MarketingComments" AS marketing_comments,
    "InternalComments" AS internal_comments,
    "Photo" AS photo,
    "CustomFields" AS custom_fields,
    "Tags" AS tags,
    "SearchDetails" AS search_details,
    "LastEditedBy" AS last_edited_by,
    "ValidFrom" AS valid_from,
    "ValidTo" AS valid_to
  FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WAREHOUSE_STOCKITEMS
) t
grain: stock_item_id, multiple rows per item before filtering; include version_row_number to pick latest
accepted.description: Choose the latest valid version of stock items using ValidFrom/ValidTo. One row per StockItemID representing the most recent version by ValidFrom descending. Useful when the stock item table is versioned. | Use for: Select current/latest stock item attributes; Detect changes across versions by comparing rows where version_row_number>1

accepted.name: latest_stockitem_version_only
grain: stock_item_id, one row per stock item (latest version)
accepted.description: Filter to the latest stock item version using latest_stockitem_valid_version CTE's version_row_number. Use for analyses that require a single canonical row per StockItemID. | Use for: Canonical stock item attributes for joins; Prevent duplicate/multiple-version joins when analyzing sales

accepted.name: vehicle_temperatures_recent_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  vt."VehicleTemperatureID" AS vehicle_temperature_id,
  vt."VehicleRegistration" AS vehicle_registration,
  vt."ChillerSensorNumber" AS chiller_sensor_number,
  vt."RecordedWhen" AS recorded_when,
  vt."Temperature" AS temperature,
  vt."FullSensorData" AS full_sensor_data,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vt."VehicleRegistration", vt."ChillerSensorNumber" ORDER BY vt."RecordedWhen" DESC NULLS LAST) AS reading_rank_desc,
  AVG(vt."Temperature") OVER (PARTITION BY vt."VehicleRegistration", vt."ChillerSensorNumber" ORDER BY vt."RecordedWhen" ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_temp_7
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WAREHOUSE_VEHICLETEMPERATURES vt
grain: vehicle_temperature_id, one row per sensor reading
accepted.description: Windowed temperatures per vehicle sensor showing latest reading and running metrics. Exposes row_number per sensor ordered by RecordedWhen and a 7-reading moving average (by recorded order). Use to detect recent temperature trends per vehicle/sensor. | Use for: Get latest reading per vehicle/sensor by filtering reading_rank_desc = 1; Analyze temperature trends and detect sensor drift using moving averages

accepted.name: customer_transactions_financials
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "CustomerID" AS customer_id,
  "TransactionTypeID" AS transaction_type_id,
  TRY_TO_DATE("TransactionDate") AS transaction_date,
  SUM("AmountExcludingTax") AS sum_amount_excluding_tax,
  SUM("TaxAmount") AS sum_tax_amount,
  SUM("TransactionAmount") AS sum_transaction_amount,
  MAX("OutstandingBalance") AS outstanding_balance,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  MAX("IsFinalized") AS any_finalized
FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.SALES_CUSTOMERTRANSACTIONS
GROUP BY "CustomerID", "TransactionTypeID", TRY_TO_DATE("TransactionDate")
grain: customer_id, transaction_type_id, transaction_date — aggregated transactions per day/type/customer
accepted.description: Aggregated customer financial transactions by customer and transaction date. Provides measures for receivables and payments analysis. TransactionDate stored as VARCHAR so TO_DATE attempted in grouping. | Use for: Aging and receivables analysis; Payments vs charges by date and customer
